name: @office/reference-scenario
description: Office end-to-end construction reference scenario (OFF-037): THE deterministic integration-acceptance composition that wires the landed packages into one golden chain — model adapter fixture delivers an element mutation -> change detection -> quantity/cost impact recorded through domain-cost's typed command path -> schedule adapter fixture delivers the activity update -> schedule impact through domain-schedule -> change evidence packet assembled under the agents EvidenceSet discipline -> approval routed and decided through workflows -> EXECUTION of the approved change through the canonical command services -> the in-memory ledger + every linked projection reflects the executed change. Proves the two named invariants: (1) every linked projection agrees on the causal IDs (the causality chain walked event -> command -> aggregate -> projection -> evidence, end to end); (2) no duplicate canonical records appear — including under replay of the same adapter notifications (the adapters' source-version discipline) and on run-twice byte-identical world + ledger. Deterministic in-memory composition only: injected clock/id suppliers, no persistence (not even type-only), no sync/client-sync/app-runtime/marketplace/security/app-sdk/adapters-sdk/test-fixtures, no network, no LLM/AI calls. Generic fixture vocabulary only. Depends only on the four landed adapters, the four seeded domain command packages, workflows, agents (the EvidenceSet discipline), events (the ledger identity semantics), contracts, domain-kernel, authz, and the two intelligence engines' detection surfaces.
